# Försvarsindustrins nästa kapitel

**Feed**: placerapodden  
**Published**: 2026-07-01  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Defense analyst Martin Bolt-Krismas discusses the Ukraine war's trajectory, a wave of private capital flowing into defense-tech and AI (Anduril, Helsing, Stark, Palantir), and Europe's push toward consolidation and standardization in its defense industry, highlighted by the upcoming KNDS tank-maker listing. Large European primes Rheinmetall and Saab have both pulled back this year despite rising defense budgets, while Europe is seen as lagging the US in both defense-tech scale and AI (Mistral vs. Anthropic/OpenAI).

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 RHM — Rheinmetall | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Aktien ner nästan 40% i år efter förlorad fregattorder; försvarsbudgetökningar redan inprisade.

#### Reasoning

Martin notes Rheinmetall has fallen sharply (~40% YTD, ~20% recently) after losing a major frigate order, suggesting the market had already priced in defense-budget growth and is reassessing execution risk across large European primes.

#### Sell Triggers

- Further large contract losses
- European defense budget growth stalling or being delayed

> *"Om man tittar på Rheinmetall, den är ner nästan 40% i år. Bara då en 20% nu i dagarna egentligen när de förlorade en stor order på fregatter egentligen."*

---

### 🟠 SAAB-B — Saab | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Aktien ner 5-10% i år i linje med en bredare nedgång bland stora europeiska försvarsbolag.

#### Reasoning

Grouped with Rheinmetall as a large European defense prime that has pulled back this year even as defense budgets are set to rise, implying the market may have already priced in much of the budget-growth story.

#### Sell Triggers

- Continued share-price weakness despite rising defense budgets
- Order losses similar to Rheinmetall's

> *"Och det är samma sak med Sabe, väl ner också kanske 5-10 procent i år."*

---

### 🟠 PLTR — Palantir | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Ledande AI-försvarsbolag men aktien har korrigerat kraftigt (200->110 dollar) efter övervärdering; kontroversiellt ägarskap av kritisk infrastruktur utomlands.

#### Reasoning

Martin flags Palantir as the dominant AI-defense name but notes its stock corrected substantially after being overvalued, and cites political controversy over a US company controlling allied countries' healthcare and defense infrastructure as a risk to its European growth story.

#### Sell Triggers

- Escalating political backlash over foreign control of critical infrastructure
- European sovereign AI/defense alternatives gaining share
- Further valuation correction

> *"Antal palantir är väl det stora där men samtidigt deras aktier faller från 200 dollar till 110."*

---
